{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|But consider the alternative: you could be mining ''that'' stuff while I prepare Rybettian Shac for Moruth Doole.|XDL-67 to Ramsey Lanclo|<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Rybettian Shac''' was a [[Rybet/Legends|Rybettian]] delicacy favored by [[Moruth Doole]]. The [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]] [[XDL-67]] once opined that giving away a [[keon]] that cost [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ramsey Lanclo]] 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] [[Customs official/Legends|agent]] [[Hewat]] was preferable to [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] and being forced to cook Rybettian Shac for Doole.
